SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable sulfur and hydrogen material-balance receipt for a hydrotreating screening case.

The calculation is deliberately limited to stoichiometric accounting. It does not predict reaction kinetics, catalyst performance, operating conditions, heat duty, recycle requirements, liquid yield, or product compliance.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurBalance calculate(double feedMassKg, double feedSulfurMassFraction, double targetProductSulfurMassFraction, double hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole)
      Calculate a sulfur and hydrogen material-balance receipt.
      Parameters:
      feedMassKg - feed mass in kilograms
      feedSulfurMassFraction - sulfur mass fraction in the feed
      targetProductSulfurMassFraction - requested sulfur mass fraction on the calculated liquid product mass
      hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole - explicit hydrogen consumption assumption in moles of H2 per mole of sulfur removed; must be at least one
      Returns:
      immutable balance receipt

    • calculateForAssay

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurBalance calculateForAssay(double feedMassKg, OilAssayCharacterisation assay, double targetProductSulfurMassFraction, double hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole)
      Calculate a receipt using the bulk sulfur reconstructed by an oil assay.

      The assay is read but is not mutated.

      Parameters:
      feedMassKg - feed mass in kilograms
      assay - oil assay providing the bulk sulfur mass fraction
      targetProductSulfurMassFraction - requested sulfur mass fraction on the calculated liquid product mass
      hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole - explicit hydrogen consumption assumption in moles of H2 per mole of sulfur removed
      Returns:
      immutable balance receipt
